// CASE chunk_prelude_assert_string expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  assert(width > 0, 'width must be positive; we await one chunk at a time');
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE chunk_prelude_throw expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency2<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  if (width < 1) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(width, 'width', 'Cannot await zero workers');
  }
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE chunk_prelude_doc_comment expect=pass
/// Runs [operation] on [items], at most [width] at a time.
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency3<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  // Each loop pass awaits one chunk.
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE chunk_prelude_real_await expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency4<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  await warmUp();
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE chunk_prelude_await_decl expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency5<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final limit = await loadLimit();
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE chunk_prelude_await_if expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency6<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  if (items.isEmpty) {
    await audit();
  }
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_inorder_canonical expect=pass
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T item) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

// CASE dart_steps_canonical expect=pass
Future<void> inOrderSteps(
  List<Future<void> Function()> steps, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final step in steps) {
    await step();
  }
}

// CASE dart_inorder_static expect=pass
class Ordered {
  static Future<void> inOrder<T>(
    Iterable<T> items,
    Future<void> Function(T item) step, {
    required String reason,
  }) async {
    for (final item in items) {
      await step(item);
    }
  }
}

// CASE dart_inorder_impostor_extra expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder2<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T item) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await step(item);
    await log(item);
  }
}

const migrationReason = 'Each migration step needs the previous schema in place';

// CASE dart_calls expect=pass
Future<void> run(List<int> rows) async {
  await inOrder(rows, (row) async => save(row), reason: 'Each row update reads the previous balance');
  await inOrder(rows, save, reason: migrationReason);
  await inOrderSteps([() => a(), () => b()], reason: 'Stage two needs the tables from stage one');
  await inOrder(
    rows,
    save,
    reason: 'Each row update reads the balance '
        'written by the previous row',
  );
}
